name: Detect trending topics on YouTube and alert via Telegram

parameters.content:
## Detect trending topics on YouTube and alert via Telegram

### How it works

This workflow runs on an hourly schedule or manually, builds YouTube search jobs from configured topics, and pages through RecentReborn search results while respecting skip and rate-limit logic. It evaluates each page, keeps new results, handles failed searches without stopping the run, then scores topics against historical behavior to detect breakout phrases or newcomer channels. When there is something noteworthy, it formats a Telegram digest and sends it to the configured chat.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger cadence if hourly checks are not desired.
- Set the trend configuration values in "Set Trend Config", including topics, whether to include Shorts, maximum pages per search, and maximum credits per run.
- Add or verify credentials/API access for the RecentReborn YouTube search endpoint used by "Fetch YouTube page".
- Configure the Telegram node with a bot credential and target chat ID/channel where digests should be sent.

### Customization

Adjust the topic list, paging limits, request spacing, breakout scoring thresholds, and Telegram message formatting to fit the niche and alert volume you want.

## Trigger and configure

Starts the workflow either on the hourly schedule or by manual execution, then loads the trend-tracking configuration used for the run.

## Plan search queue

Creates one search job per configured topic and format, then iterates through those jobs in batches until all searches are complete.

## Prepare page requests

Builds each page request, decides whether a search should be skipped due to limits or state, and spaces out allowed requests before calling the API.

## Fetch and evaluate pages

Fetches YouTube search result pages, evaluates new results and pagination state, routes follow-up page requests, and records failed searches so the loop can continue.

## Score trend signals

After search jobs finish, scores topics against their history and checks whether any breakout phrases or newcomer channels are worth reporting.

## Send Telegram digest

Formats the detected trend signals into one or more escaped HTML Telegram messages and sends the digest to the configured chat.
